relations.label: member of
relations.note: Places the environment in an environment group so the group rule set applies to it.

relations.label: billed by
relations.note: Pay-as-you-go billing through the policy's Azure subscription.

relations.label: restricted to
relations.note: Only members of this Entra security group get access to the Dataverse environment.

relations.label: location
relations.note: Valid locations and their Azure regions.

relations.label: depends on
relations.note: Firewall / IP based rules under `product.security` need a Managed Environment, so add `depends_on`.

relations.label: system_id
relations.note: The `properties.systemId` of a Microsoft.PowerPlatform/enterprisePolicies Azure resource (usually created with azapi).

relations.label: requires
relations.note: Encryption (CMK) and network injection policies require a Managed Environment.

relations.label: binds connections
relations.note: Map of connection reference logical name to connection id.

relations.label: definition from
relations.note: The variable definition ships in a solution, so deploy the solution first.

relations.label: business unit
relations.note: Optional business unit; defaults to the root business unit.

relations.label: principal
relations.note: The `system_user_id` of an application user (or a user).

relations.label: team
relations.note: A Dataverse team, for example one created with `powerplatform_data_record`.

relations.label: calls
relations.note: The scope is the environment's Dataverse URL, e.g. `${powerplatform_environment.x.dataverse.url}/.default`.

relations.label: routes makers to
relations.note: Default environment routing sends new makers to environments in this group.
